root_cause.conditional_skip: 1915 only called discoverLiveOptions when discoverRoadtripOvernightPool added fewer than 10 items. The destination provider is the component that injects the Eifel/Sauerland regional candidates, so >=10 overnight-place additions could prevent those candidates entering the initial ranking at all.
root_cause.timeout_race: 1915 wrapped initial discovery in a 12-second Promise.race. destination-provider performs 3 sequential discovery passes and each pass allows up to 18 seconds. The initial ranking could therefore run before destination discovery completed; the unfinished search could continue mutating the catalogue afterward.

change.initial_pool: Before the first refreshPortfolio(), app now always calls discoverDestinationBatch directly for cursor 0, merges its full returned candidate set, and advances discoveryCursor to 1.
change.bounded_network: Each of the provider's 3 initial passes is capped at 3.5 seconds, so the full initial destination pass finishes (including fallback regional candidates) instead of being abandoned by an outer timeout.
change.overnight_pool: Roadtrip overnight discovery runs in parallel with the destination-candidate pass; neither can conditionally suppress the other.
change.later_discovery: Background reserve discovery remains enabled, but cursor 0 is already consumed before the first ranking.
